edges.label: Named as a target of his records investigation
edges.note: Burlison: 'my investigation is following the trail into RAND, MITRE, Aerospace Corp, MIT Lincoln Labs, and the Northrop Grummans of the world.' No letter to RAND has been made public.

edges.label: Named as a target of his records investigation
edges.note: Aerospace holds the technical judgement on national security space sensing; no letter to Aerospace has been made public as of 12 August 2026.

edges.label: Holds the March 1952 Ruppelt 'flying saucer talk' recording
edges.note: By 25 June 2026 Burlison announced the laboratory had agreed to disclose it - the first FFRDC-held UAP record obtained by Congress by naming the file.
